about: Visa rules for Indian ordinary passport holders, summarised from research on 16 October 2026. Each record links its sources. Rules change often.

visaKeys.OT: Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa

records.name: Brunei
records.rule: Visa required. Apply before travel at the Brunei High Commission in New Delhi (single entry, about B$20, 30 days).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Indonesia
records.rule: e-VOA or visa on arrival, 30 days, about IDR 500,000.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Vietnam
records.rule: e-visa, up to 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Cambodia
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 30 days, about US$36.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Laos
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 30 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Sri Lanka
records.rule: Free ETA or visa on arrival, 30 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.rule: Visa-free, 90 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bangladesh
records.rule: Visa required in advance, no visa on arrival. Government fee waived for Indians, small service charge. Tourist visa issuance was reported paused in early 2026 and resuming in October 2026, so confirm it is open. The Ministry of External Affairs has a standing advisory against travel there.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bhutan
records.rule: No visa, but an entry permit (free, online or at the border) and a Sustainable Development Fee of INR 1,200 per person per night, fixed to Aug 2027.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Oman
records.rule: Visa required. 14-day visa on arrival only with a valid US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan or Schengen visa; otherwise e-visa. Needs return ticket, hotel booking and health insurance.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bahrain
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 14 days; on arrival for holders of a valid UAE, UK, US, Saudi or Schengen visa.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Saudi Arabia
records.rule: India is not on the official tourist e-visa list. An e-visa or visa on arrival is for holders of a valid US, UK or Schengen visa; otherwise embassy visa or the package-visa pilot (about SAR 4,000 minimum). Sources disagree, so confirm before planning.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Jordan
records.rule: e-visa or visa on arrival, 30 days. The Jordan Pass waives the visa fee only for a stay of 2 or more nights.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kazakhstan
records.rule: Visa-free, 14 days.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kyrgyzstan
records.rule: e-visa, up to 60 days. Expect an invitation-letter step after applying.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Uzbekistan
records.rule: 30 days visa-free only with a valid multiple-entry visa from the US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan or South Korea and an onward air ticket (rule from 1 Sep 2026); the stay must fall within that visa. Otherwise e-visa, about US$25 for one month.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Azerbaijan
records.rule: e-visa, 30 days (airport kiosk about US$30; prior e-visa for land borders).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Armenia
records.rule: e-visa, 90 days; visa on arrival with a valid visa from the EU/Schengen, US, UK, Canada or Japan.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Japan
records.rule: e-visa for people residing in India, tourism, single entry, up to 90 days, through authorised agencies.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Taiwan
records.rule: Visa required, but a free online Travel Authorization Certificate (14 days) is available with a visa or residence card from the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea or a Schengen state that is valid or expired under 10 years ago.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Philippines
records.rule: Visa-free 14 days for tourism; 30 days with a valid US, Schengen, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan or Singapore visa. Needs hotel booking, proof of funds and an onward ticket.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Switzerland
records.rule: Schengen visa required (one visa covers about 29 countries; multiple entry advised). Apply 3 to 6 months ahead. Entry/Exit System biometric registration is live since 10 Apr 2026.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kosovo
records.rule: Visa required for Indian passports. Exempt for up to 15 days with a valid multiple entry Schengen visa or Schengen residence permit per Kosovo MFA as quoted by Wikipedia. Register address with police within 3 days. Check US or UK visa easing with Kosovo MFA before relying on it.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bulgaria
records.rule: Schengen visa required. Bulgaria is a full Schengen member since 1 Jan 2025 (land borders), so a valid Schengen short stay visa covers entry. 90 days in 180 shared across the area. Standard Schengen fee 90 euro, about 15 days processing.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Romania
records.rule: Schengen visa required. Romania is a full Schengen member since 1 Jan 2025 (land borders), so a valid Schengen short stay visa covers entry. 90 days in 180 shared across the area. Standard Schengen fee 90 euro, about 15 days processing.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Cyprus
records.rule: EU but not Schengen. National visa required, but a valid double or multiple entry Schengen C visa (or Bulgarian, Croatian, Romanian national visa) gives entry up to 90 days in 180. Days in Cyprus do not count in Schengen. US or UK visa does not ease entry.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Saint Lucia
records.rule: Visa on arrival up to 6 weeks per MEA and Wikipedia, but the Saint Lucia government portal still lists a visa for some nationalities (EC$125 single, EC$190 multiple, 5 working days, return ticket, hotel proof). Confirm with airline before flying.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
records.rule: Visa not required. MEA says 30 days (tourist and business, no extension), Wikipedia says 3 months; officers decide on arrival. Need passport valid 6 months, return ticket, accommodation proof, funds.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Grenada
records.rule: Visa not required, 90 days per MEA (Wikipedia says 3 months). Need passport valid 6 months and return or onward ticket. Check for an airline requested electronic immigration form before travel.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Dominica
records.rule: Visa not required, up to 180 days per MEA (Wikipedia says 6 months). Need passport, return ticket, accommodation proof and funds. Ferry arrivals from Guadeloupe, Martinique or Saint Lucia clear immigration with an entry form.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Malaysia
records.rule: Indian ordinary passport: visa exempt for up to 30 days (tourism, business, social visit, transit) until 31 Dec 2026. Needs passport valid 6 months, return ticket, accommodation proof. Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) must be filed online within 3 days before landing, free. Work or study needs a visa. Rule ends 31 Dec 2026 unless renewed: trips spanning January 2027 are UNCERTAIN; a paid eVisa fallback (RM 100 reported by a secondary site) is UNVERIFIED.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Singapore
records.rule: ICA lists India among nationalities that need a valid entry visa; apply online through the ICA Entry Visa e-service via a Singapore based authorised agent; SG Arrival Card (SGAC) free, submit within 3 days before arrival. Stay is set by e-Pass at the checkpoint (commonly 30 days, UNVERIFIED). Visa fee about SGD 30 to 40 plus agent charge, UNVERIFIED. No easing found for a US, UK, Schengen or Canada visa, UNVERIFIED. Transit without visa rules not checked.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Nepal
records.rule: No visa for Indian citizens. Carry a valid passport or Election Commission voter ID card (government photo ID also accepted per old MHA guidance); persons above 65 and below 15 exempt from ID with other photo document; air entry requires ID. No fee. Stay limit and registration after long stays UNVERIFIED. Nepal bans larger INR notes (INR 200 and above per older guidance, UNVERIFIED): carry INR 100 notes or less, or use cards, UPI is partly usable.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Thailand
records.rule: From 15 Sep 2026 Indian ordinary passport holders get 30 days visa free for tourism (previously 60 days). Extension once by up to 30 days at immigration, fee reported 1,900 THB. Visa exempt land border entries capped at 2 per calendar year. Entered before 15 Sep keeps the 60 days stamped. Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) free, submit within 3 days before arrival (beware copycat sites). Visa on arrival no longer applies to India. Onward ticket and funds can be asked.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: South Korea
records.rule: Indian ordinary passport: Korean short stay visa (C-3-9) needed. K-ETA exemption (to 31 Dec 2026) covers only 22 listed jurisdictions (US, Canada, Singapore, UK, Germany etc.), not India; K-ETA is for visa free nationals only. Visa fee INR 3,600 single entry to 90 days, INR 8,100 multiple (effective 1 Aug 2026, via visa application centre, plus service charge about INR 1,100). Processing about 10 working days. Group tourist visa route also exists. e-Arrival Card online before arrival. Easing by US, UK, Schengen or Canada visa for Indians: UNVERIFIED, not found. Visa free Jeju not available to Indians (UNVERIFIED).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Canada
records.rule: Indian citizens need a Temporary Resident Visa (visitor visa), CAD 100 plus biometrics CAD 85 (valid 10 years; family cap CAD 170); stay up to 6 months; processing reported about 3 to 8 weeks (secondary sites). eTA is not available to Indian passport holders: the conditional eTA list (valid US visa or recent Canadian visa) covers 17 countries and does not include India, so a valid US visa does NOT waive the Canadian visa for Indians. Single and multiple entry visas decided by officer; may need ITRs and funds proof.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: United States of America
records.rule: B1/B2 visitor visa needed (stay set by CBP up to 6 months). MRV application fee about USD 185 (not re-verified today, UNVERIFIED); a new USD 250 Visa Integrity Fee was enacted 4 Jul 2025 and collection start was uncertain through 2026 (UNCERTAIN, check consulate). Visa bond pilot (USD 5,000 to 15,000) covers designated countries; India not listed in snippets found, UNVERIFIED; the programme was formalised by a Federal Register rule dated 3 Aug 2026. Apply in country of residence/nationality; interview waiver rules tightened (UNVERIFIED). US consular exchange rate 98 INR per USD from 25 May 2026. ESTA not available for Indians. Wait times for appointments vary.
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: United Arab Emirates
records.rule: Standard route: pre-arranged tourist e-visa (30 days single entry about USD 90 via airline/agent, 60 days about USD 177 per Emirates table, 96 hour transit USD 49, 48 hour USD 10). Conditional visa on arrival for Indian ordinary passport holders: 14 days AED 100, extendable once 14 days for AED 250; or 60 day AED 250 non extendable (Envoy), requires valid US visa or green card, UK residence permit or EU residence permit (official GDRFA/UAE embassy wording is green card or residence permit; some secondary sites say visa), documents valid 6 months, confirmed return ticket. Canada, Singapore, Japan, Korea, Australia, NZ: only residence permit qualifies, not a visitor visa. Schengen visa only: UNCERTAIN, probably does not qualify; confirm with airline. Indians with such eligibility may also apply online pre-arrival (GDRFA service fee AED 253).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Georgia
records.rule: Indian citizens need a visa unless they hold a valid visa or residence permit from US, UK, Schengen, Canada (and Australia, Japan, Korea, NZ, Israel, Ireland, GCC states per secondary lists): then visa free up to 90 days in any 180 days. Qualifying visa must be valid at entry. Otherwise eVisa at evisa.gov.ge: consular fee from USD 20 plus DuVerify step USD 15 (total about USD 35; secondary source), minimum about 5 working days. From 1 Jan 2026 tourists must hold health/accident insurance (minimum cover reported inconsistently: GEL 30,000 vs USD 30,000, UNCERTAIN).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Germany
records.rule: Schengen short stay (type C) visa required, up to 90 days in any 180 days. Fee EUR 90 (about INR 9,590) plus visa centre service charge about INR 400 to 3,125 and travel insurance (about EUR 30,000 cover). Apply 6 months to 15 days before travel at the consulate or VFS/other centre; apply at the country of main destination. A US, UK or Canada visa does NOT waive the Schengen visa for Indians. ETIAS does not apply to Indians (visa required nationals). EES biometric entry system live since 10 Apr 2026 per a secondary source (probable).
records.note: Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Qatar
records.rule: Indian passport holders get a visa on arrival, not free entry. Book an approved hotel on the Discover Qatar site before travel (India is on the mandatory list), then pay the QAR 100 fee (about INR 2,600) at the airport, or apply in advance for a Hayya A1 e-visa. Passport valid 3 months, confirmed return ticket. Transit: Qatar Airways passengers with a layover of 6 hours or more who are not visa-free can get a transit visa at the Discover Qatar Transit Desk in Hamad airport. A traveller reports that a Hayya visa was needed for a transit stay beyond 12 hours (first-hand report, not yet confirmed on an official page). Earlier text here claiming free 30-day entry for Indians came from a secondary site and was wrong.
records.note: Probable, not final. The 12 hour transit rule is a traveller report. Confirm on hayya.qa before you fly.

records.name: China
records.rule: Visa required before travel for Indian ordinary passport holders. Apply for an L tourist visa through the Chinese Embassy and Consulates in India and their visa application service centres (online form first, then passport submission in person). Standard processing is about 4 working days. Reported embassy fee for Indians is INR 2,900 for single entry under a reduced fee scheme said to run to 31 December 2026 (an older list shows INR 3,900), plus a service centre fee; UNVERIFIED because the embassy pages were not readable. Passport validity: commonly 6 months, UNVERIFIED. India is not on China's 240 hour visa free transit list (55 countries, read on the Chinese consulate Chicago page), and no unilateral visa free entry for Indians was found. No US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa waives or eases the Chinese visa for Indians.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: exact current fee, passport validity and fingerprint rules (embassy page returned no content; fee figures come from agent sites). MEA lists China on its travel advisory index, content not read. Restricted areas such as Tibet need extra permits. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Russia
records.rule: Visa required. The official Russian MFA e-visa portal (electronic-visa.kdmid.ru) grants a unified e-visa to nationals of 64 states; a secondary source says India is on the list. Reported terms: single entry, stay up to 16 days, valid 60 days from issue, processed in about 4 calendar days, fee about USD 52 (about INR 4,500), entry through listed border points including Moscow and St Petersburg airports. Passport validity, the exact fee and the list of entry points are UNVERIFIED. The Russian Embassy in India page says Indians need a visa but was blocked by a captcha. No US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa eases the Russian visa for Indians.
records.note: Ministry of External Affairs warned in September 2026 about recruitment into the Russian armed forces (from news reports). UNVERIFIED: India's presence on the e-visa list and the fee (embassy page blocked by captcha, so the aggregator figure was used). MEA has warned Indians against travel linked to joining the Russian armed forces (news reports, September 2026), and Russia sits on the MEA advisory index. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Israel
records.rule: Visa required; Indians are not eligible for the visa free ETA-IL. Indian passport holders resident in India can apply for an eVisa B2 (visit, tourism, business, short studies) on the official Israeli portal israel-entry.piba.gov.il, launched in 2025 per the Embassy of Israel in New Delhi. Handling fee 105 NIS (about INR 2,500), plus a logistics fee of about INR 1,985 charged on an agent site; validity up to 90 days at the consul's decision. Processing time, passport validity and exact entry points are UNVERIFIED. No US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa was found to waive or ease this for Indians.
records.note: Check the Ministry of External Affairs advisory (date unread) before travel. UNVERIFIED: gov.il was blocked and the PIBA page needed JavaScript, so fees come from search snippets. The MEA page found says Indians are advised not to travel to Iran or Israel till further notice; its date was not read, so check the current MEA advisory before planning. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Mongolia
records.rule: Visa required. Mongolia's official portal evisa.mn issues e-visas (tourist K2 type listed by the Immigration Agency) to nationals of an eligible country list; passport must be valid at least 180 days, the e-visa is non-extendable, and the fee is non-refundable. An aggregator shows an e-visa for Indians at about USD 120 for a single entry and 30 days, and also mentions visa on arrival; both are UNVERIFIED, as is whether India is on the official e-visa list. Otherwise apply at a Mongolian mission. Foreigners must register within the time stated on the portal. No visa from the US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea was confirmed to waive or ease the Mongolian visa for Indians.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: India's eligibility, fee and stay length (portal pages loaded only partly; the fee came from an aggregator). No MEA advisory was checked for Mongolia. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Ghana
records.rule: Indian ordinary passport holders are not visa exempt, so a visa is needed before travel. Since 25 May 2026 Ghana runs an official online eVisa portal (Ghana Immigration Service with the Foreign Ministry) for tourism or business, offered as an alternative to applying at a Ghana mission. Approval usually takes 72 to 96 hours, the eVisa is emailed and shown printed or digital at any port of entry. A specimen tourist eVisa on the portal shows single entry, 30 days stay, and a note that the passport must be valid at least 6 months beyond the stay. Visa on arrival has been replaced by pre-approval only (host sponsored, not for casual tourists). Fee: UNVERIFIED (not shown on pages read). Yellow fever vaccination certificate: UNVERIFIED on official pages read; Ghana is widely reported to require it for travellers aged 9 months and over, so carry the certificate. An Indian's US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa does not waive or ease the Ghana visa (no official source says it does).
records.note: Portal read but fee, Indian specific stay length and yellow fever rule are UNVERIFIED; Ghana mission in India page not reachable (domain did not resolve); MEA advisory for Ghana not checked. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Nigeria
records.rule: Indian citizens need a visa before travel; no visa on arrival was found for Indians. Nigeria Immigration Service offers a Tourism Visa (F5A) through its e-Visa portal: single entry, 30 days, not extendable. Requirements per NIS: passport valid at least 6 months, passport photo, return ticket, hotel booking or host address, and 180 days bank statement. Business single entry visa is also 30 days. Visas over 90 days or other classes are through an embassy. Landing and exit cards are mandatory for all passengers (from 1 May 2025). Fee: UNVERIFIED. Yellow fever card: listed as an entry document on Nigeria's Foreign Ministry travel advisory page, so carry it. Ebola screening info was updated on the UK FCDO page on 28 September 2026 (details not read). An Indian's US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa does not waive or ease the Nigerian visa; it is only useful as supporting evidence.
records.note: Fee and Indian specific processing time UNVERIFIED; e-visa portal needs login so not read. India MEA advisory for Nigeria not found on the MEA list snippet; UK FCDO advises against all travel to parts of Nigeria and US says reconsider travel. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Bolivia
records.rule: UNVERIFIED for Indians. Bolivia sorts nationalities into three groups (visa free, visa without prior authorisation, prior consular authorisation). Non-official guides say the US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan and South Korea became visa free for 90 days from 1 December 2025, and say India is not in that group. Sources conflict on India: Wikipedia lists visa on arrival (90 days) but cites a note that visa on arrival is no longer available (April 2025), and one guide places most of Asia in a visa on arrival group (USD 30 to 52). Plan on getting a visa from a Bolivian embassy or consulate before travel and confirm with the Bolivian embassy that covers India (not located) and the migration portal migracion.gob.bo (not read). Free online pre-registration SIGEMIG with QR code is expected for all visitors (opens 30 days before travel). Passport validity 6 months, onward ticket and accommodation proof expected. Yellow fever: required for arrivals from endemic countries and for the Amazon lowlands (Beni, Pando, Santa Cruz area below about 2,300 m); CDC lists the vaccine as required for all arriving travellers aged 1 year and over, while other sources call it route dependent; carry the physical yellow booklet. Indian visa holders: no Bolivian easing found; a US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa is not known to waive it.
records.note: Category not confirmed: sources conflict on visa on arrival versus visa required. UNVERIFIED: no official Bolivian government or embassy page was read, so India's exact category, fee and stay length are not confirmed; sources conflict. Verify with the embassy before booking. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Cuba
records.rule: Indian citizens need a tourist visa before boarding; no visa on arrival. Since 1 July 2025 the old tourist card has been replaced by an electronic visa (eVisa), reported as single entry, 90 days stay, extendable once for 90 days, linked to the passport. Apply through Cuba's official eVisa portal (evisacuba.cu, could not be read: certificate error) or the Cuban embassy in New Delhi (embassy page not read). Also required: the free D'Viajeros online customs and health form, filled within about 7 days before arrival (QR code), passport valid 6 months beyond entry, medical travel insurance, return or onward ticket and accommodation details. Fee: UNVERIFIED (US based agent pages mention about USD 85 and up, not official). Yellow fever certificate: UNVERIFIED; commonly only asked if arriving from a country with yellow fever risk. Canada's advice says Visa and Mastercard cards stopped being accepted in Cuba from 6 June 2026, so carry cash. An Indian's US, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, NZ, Japan or Korea visa does not waive or ease the Cuban visa.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: evisacuba.cu only seen via search snippet (fetch failed on certificate), Cuban embassy in India page not read, fee and Indian specific rule from secondary sources; MEA advisory for Cuba not checked. Power cuts and fuel shortages reported; check current conditions. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Kuwait
records.rule: E-visa. Kuwait's Ministry of Interior portal (kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw) lists a Tourism Visa: passport valid at least 6 months, entry permit valid 30 days from issue, stay up to 90 days from entry, single entry, no work. Indian passports were reported (traveller video, Jan 2026) to get the tourist e-visa for about KWD 10 (about Rs 2,800); the portal page I could read did not list nationalities or fees, so Indian eligibility and fee are not confirmed from an official page. Pay and apply online before travel, entry at Kuwait International Airport. Yellow fever certificate is only needed when arriving from a yellow fever risk country (not direct from India); this was not checked on an official Kuwait page. Indian US/UK/Schengen visas: no waiver found, the e-visa route itself is what matters, so none marked as easing. MEA: no restriction found, check MEA advisories for regional security.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: Indian eligibility list and exact fee on the official portal (page is JavaScript heavy; MOFA page returned 403). Rules for Indians have changed several times. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Pakistan
records.rule: Visa required, and no general tourist visa for Indian passport holders. Per secondary sources (Wikipedia, easyvisa.pk) Indians are not eligible for the online e-visa and must apply through a Pakistani mission; only family and friends visit, business, transit and pilgrimage categories are available. Indians are limited to designated entry points (Wagah land border, Islamabad, Lahore and Karachi airports), usually enter and exit by the same point, and no extensions. Passport validity and fees not confirmed. Indian direct travel by land and air has been heavily affected by India-Pakistan tensions since 2025 and Wagah/Attari crossings were suspended in 2025; current status UNVERIFIED. Polio vaccination certificate is generally asked of long stayers; yellow fever only from risk countries. Third country visas (US, UK, Schengen etc.) do not ease entry. MEA advises against travel to Pakistan border areas and Indians should check current MEA advisories.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: official NADRA portal returned Access Denied; facts come from secondary sources. Practically not open for tourism. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Myanmar
records.rule: E-visa. Official portal evisa.moip.gov.mm exists (page text did not render). Per Myanmar consulate and secondary sources the tourist e-visa is US$50 (about Rs 4,200), 28 days, single entry, valid 90 days from issue, approval letter shown on arrival; express US$56; business US$70 for 70 days. Indians are reported eligible (UNVERIFIED on the official portal). Passport should be valid 6 months. Entry usually through Yangon, Mandalay or Nay Pyi Taw airports; land entry through the India-Myanmar border at Moreh/Tamu and Zokhawthar/Rih is limited and permits and restricted area rules apply (UNVERIFIED). Yellow fever certificate only from risk countries; not checked officially. Indian US/UK/Schengen visas do not ease entry. MEA has long advised caution and avoiding travel to conflict areas in Myanmar; check the current MEA advisory (not read).
records.note: UNVERIFIED: Indian eligibility and current fee on the official portal; MEA advisory text not read. Civil conflict, elections and martial law zones. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Tajikistan
records.rule: E-visa at evisa.tj (portal loaded but gave no readable text). Per Wikipedia and travel guides: Indians need an e-visa; single entry US$30 (about Rs 2,500) or multiple entry US$50 (about Rs 4,200), stay up to 60 days, valid 90 days from issue, processed in about 1 to 5 business days, usable at any border crossing. A GBAO (Pamir) permit is an optional extra of US$20 on the same application. Passport valid 6 months. Yellow fever certificate not required (no risk), UNVERIFIED on an official page. Indian US/UK/Schengen visas do not ease entry. No MEA restriction found, but check for border advisories near Afghanistan.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: official portal text did not render; fees from secondary sources. One aggregator showed US$50 for India, so recheck. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Timor-Leste
records.rule: Visa on arrival at Dili Presidente Nicolau Lobato airport or Dili seaport: single entry, up to 30 days, USD 30 (about Rs 2,500) in cash. Passport valid 6 months from entry with a blank page. Expect to show return or onward ticket, accommodation and proof of funds (one reference lists USD 150 per day). Extension to 90 days total possible in country for USD 35 or USD 75. Indians holding ordinary passports are not visa exempt (the October 2024 exemption is for India diplomatic and official passports only). Land border at Batugade reportedly restricted for most nationalities, so pre-arranged authorisation may be needed. No US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visa eases or waives this. Yellow fever certificate: UNVERIFIED, normally only asked from travellers arriving from endemic countries.
records.note: UNVERIFIED against official source: Timor-Leste immigration site not reached; only Wikipedia and a tour operator guide read. Indian ordinary passport VOA confirmed only via an Indian visa agency snippet (riavisas.in). Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Turkmenistan
records.rule: Visa required for Indians. The Turkmen embassy in New Delhi page (read) says applications are made in person at the Consular Section with a Visa Verification Number or certified invitation letter issued by the State Migration Service (arranged via a licensed Turkmen travel agency), passport valid 6 months beyond departure, photo, and for stays of a month or more an original HIV/AIDS certificate. Embassy fees: single entry 10 days USD 35, 1 month USD 55, transit up to 5 days USD 35; processing 10 business days, expedited double fee. A new e-Visa portal was announced from 2 October 2026 with 24 hours to 7 business days processing, but registration for applicants was reported not yet possible (UNVERIFIED). Transit and tourist travel is normally tightly controlled and tourists are usually accompanied by a guide. Entry points include Ashgabat airport and land borders. No US/UK/Schengen/Canada visa waives or eases this. Yellow fever certificate: UNVERIFIED.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: official e-Visa portal could not be reached (evisa.gov.tm did not resolve) and the embassy page may be dated; Indian-specific e-Visa eligibility and fees not confirmed. Caravanistan notes a Covid vaccination copy requirement in older rules, unconfirmed. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Belarus
records.rule: Visa free for up to 30 days for Indians, but only under conditions set out by the Belarus embassy in India (page read): arrive and leave via Minsk National Airport (the Belarus MFA page lists other airports too, but the India embassy page names Minsk only), not from or to Russia. Required: valid ordinary passport (90 days beyond departure per MFA), at least EUR 25 per day in funds, medical insurance of EUR 10,000 valid in Belarus (can be bought at the airport), a valid multiple entry EU or Schengen visa that has already been used with an entry stamp, and a ticket showing departure from Minsk within 30 days. Register with local Interior Ministry within 5 days if staying more than 5 days (hotels do it). An e-visa for Indians was reported (EUR 60 plus EUR 6 service per Wikipedia) but UNVERIFIED from official sources. Only a Schengen/EU multiple entry visa eases entry; US, UK, Canada, Japan visas do not replace it. Yellow fever certificate: UNVERIFIED.
records.note: Without a used multiple entry Schengen visa the visa free route is closed and a regular visa or e-visa is needed (e-visa details UNVERIFIED). Check MEA and your airline before travel. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Moldova
records.rule: Indians need a visa (Moldova MFA list of visa-required countries, page read, includes India). Exception marked [2] for India: holders of a valid visa (not transit) or residence permit issued by an EU or Schengen state, the UK, the USA or Canada may travel to Moldova without a Moldovan visa during its validity. Otherwise apply for an e-Visa at evisa.gov.md (up to about 20 days processing per Wikipedia). E-visa fee, stay length and entry points: UNVERIFIED. Passport validity about 3 months beyond stay (Wikipedia, UNVERIFIED). Entry normally by Chisinau airport. Yellow fever certificate: UNVERIFIED.
records.note: Easing confirmed from official MFA list; Japan, Korea, Australia, NZ visas are not listed as easing. evisa.gov.md could not be fetched (certificate error), so e-visa fees UNVERIFIED. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Senegal
records.rule: Visa free for Indian ordinary passport holders for stays up to 90 days (per aggregator sources; no official Senegal page naming India was readable). Need passport valid at least 6 months, return or onward ticket. Yellow fever certificate: not mandatory for entry per Discover Senegal tourism page, but vaccination strongly recommended; Indian rules separately require a certificate on return from yellow fever risk countries, so carry one. Policy watch: in July 2025 Senegal's Council of Ministers backed a mandatory e-visa on a reciprocity basis for nationals of countries that demand visas from Senegalese; India requires visas from Senegalese, so India may be affected. As of mid September 2026 no start date, fee or country list was published officially. Entry via Dakar Blaise Diagne airport (DSS). No US/UK/Schengen/Canada visa waiver or easing applies.
records.note: Senegal planned a reciprocal e-visa (announced July 2025, no start date found). UNVERIFIED: no official Senegal government or embassy page read; the 90 day free stay for India and the possible reciprocal e-visa both need checking with the Senegal embassy in New Delhi before booking. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Côte d'Ivoire
records.rule: Visa required. Indians are not on the visa exempt list; apply online for an e-visa on the official portal run by SNEDAI (snedai.com). Official page states: ordinary passport valid at least 6 months before application, fee 73 euros including bank charges for a 3 month multiple entry visa, paid by Visa or Mastercard. Three mandatory uploads: passport identity page, return air ticket booking, and a typed, signed, stamped and legalised invitation letter or accommodation certificate (missing one means automatic rejection). Approval is not guaranteed and fees are not refunded. An airport information site says apply at least 48 hours before departure and the e-visa is single entry standard (conflicts with the 3 month multiple entry wording; UNVERIFIED which applies). Yellow fever vaccination certificate is generally required for arrivals aged 1 year or more in Cote d'Ivoire (not confirmed on a page read this session; confirm with the embassy). Entry at Abidjan airport. No US/UK/Schengen/Canada visa waiver for Indians.
records.note: Fee and documents read on the official SNEDAI page; yellow fever rule and single versus multiple entry unverified; India specific eligibility not named on the page. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Mozambique
records.rule: Indians are not on the visa exempt or eTA lists seen on the official portal; the portal says travellers not eligible for visa free entry or an eTA apply for an eVisa online at evisa.gov.mz (relaunched February 2026, run with VFS Global). India is not among the six nationalities (Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Nigeria, Nepal, Somalia) barred from the portal and sent to embassies. Tourist stay 30 days. Fee: aggregator says 50 USD (UNVERIFIED); an older Wikipedia figure was 6,250 MT. Passport valid at least 6 months. Older sources say visa on arrival for 50 USD existed; after the February 2026 relaunch one aggregator says almost everyone now arranges permission online first, so do not rely on arrival. Yellow fever: certificate required only if arriving from or transiting over 12 hours in a risk country (India is not one, but Cote d'Ivoire is). Polio: Mozambique is on India's polio list, so a dose of OPV or IPV is needed at least 4 weeks before departure from India (aggregator, UNVERIFIED officially). No US/UK/Schengen visa easing found.
records.note: Portal read but India row, fee and processing time not directly confirmed; eVisa category inferred from portal structure. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Malawi
records.rule: Visa or prior authorization required before departure. Official portal notice (effective 24 Feb 2026): Category Two nationals may get visa on arrival; Category One nationals must obtain a visa or prior authorization before departure, and airlines are told to board only Category Two without a visa. India is in Category One according to a Malawi embassy press release PDF (malawiembassy.de) and an aggregator; the official portal page I read did not render the country list. Apply online at evisa.gov.mw with Visa or Master card. Fees on the portal FAQ: transit 50 USD, single entry 50 USD, 6 month multiple 150 USD, 12 month multiple 250 USD; the Immigration Department fees page snippet shows single entry 75 USD (conflict, UNVERIFIED which is current, plus a convenience fee). Alternative: sticker visa at the Malawi High Commission, New Delhi (aggregator). Print the approval letter. Yellow fever: certificate needed if arriving from a risk country such as Cote d'Ivoire (UNVERIFIED, no official page read). No US/UK/Schengen waiver found for Indians.
records.note: Official portal confirms two category system; India in Category One rests on an embassy press release of uncertain date and an aggregator. Single entry fee conflicts (50 vs 75 USD). Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Cabo Verde
records.rule: Visa required in advance for Indian ordinary passports. Since 1 January 2026 Cabo Verde stopped visa on arrival for nationals of a list of countries (about 91 to 96 reported) and says they must get an entry visa from a Cabo Verde embassy before arrival, under penalty of refused entry. India is shown as visa required by Passport Index; the official country list PDF on ease.gov.cv could not be read as text, so India's listing is not confirmed from the official file. All foreign visitors must also pre-register on the EASE platform (ease.gov.cv) up to 5 days before travel and pay the Airport Security Tax (TSA) of CVE 3,400 (about INR 3,000, UNVERIFIED conversion). Passport valid at least 6 months. International vaccination certificate may be requested; yellow fever certificate reported for arrivals from risk countries. The Cabo Verde High Commission in New Delhi handles visas (Shanti Niketan, per a tourism site). The visa-free regime (30 days, EASE) covers EU, UK, EFTA and other listed nationalities, not Indians. A US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visa is not reported to waive the visa for Indians.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: India on the official 2026 visa-required list (PDF unreadable); visa fee and processing time not found; MEA advisory not checked. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Angola
records.rule: Visa free for Indian ordinary passports for tourism, up to 30 days per visit and up to 90 days per calendar year, per Angola's visa exemption framework (in force since September 2023) and listed on India's MEA 'Visa Facility for Indian Nationals' page (Angola, 30 days, info as on 2 Feb 2026) seen via search snippet. Some aggregators list India as eVisa, so the sources disagree; check with the Angolan embassy in New Delhi or the SME immigration service before booking. Passport validity normally 6 months. Yellow fever vaccination certificate is reported to be required for travellers aged 9 months and over (UNVERIFIED, official health page not read). Entry points include Luanda Quatro de Fevereiro airport. A US/UK/Schengen visa is not needed and gives no extra benefit.
records.note: Sources conflict: visa free per India MEA snippet, e-visa per Passport Index. UNVERIFIED: MEA page blocked on direct fetch (403), read only via search snippet; no Angolan government page read; yellow fever rule and eVisa conflict unresolved. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Algeria
records.rule: Visa required before travel, issued by the Embassy of Algeria in New Delhi (B 6 Anand Niketan; visa section; VFS Global also lists Algeria for India). The embassy page lists fees for Indian nationals: tourist visa (30 days) INR 2,800 and multiple entry visa (90 days) INR 5,550, with other categories higher; payment in INR by bank cheque. Requirements per the Algerian foreign ministry: two application forms, passport valid at least 6 months, photocopy, two photos, travel insurance with repatriation cover, and for tourists a legalised accommodation certificate, hotel booking, or a travel agency certificate. Organised tours via agencies: visa within 48 hours of a complete file. Yellow fever certificate is only required when arriving from an endemic country (general rule, UNVERIFIED on official page). No Algeria visa waiver or easing exists for holders of US/UK/Schengen/Canada/Australia/NZ/Japan/Korea visas.
records.note: Tourist visa processing time and the exact tourist visa checklist not verified; MEA advisory and Sahara restricted zones not checked beyond general knowledge. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Papua New Guinea
records.rule: Visa required. PNG's Immigration and Citizenship Authority (ICA) visa on arrival list does not include India (it lists mainly Pacific nations, Singapore, UK, Canada, Japan, Israel, UAE and a few others). Indians apply for a Visitor visa in advance, by paper form or the ICA eVisa portal (evisa.ica.gov.pg) if the portal accepts the nationality (UNVERIFIED). Fee and stay length not verified; ICA fees are charged in USD. A PNG Digital Arrival Card is mandatory, submitted online up to 72 hours before arrival (ICA notice of 6 August 2026). Passport should be valid 6 months (standard, UNVERIFIED). Yellow fever certificate required if arriving from a risk country (UNVERIFIED). Holding a UK or Japan visa does not change the Indian passport's visa requirement; Indian holders of those visas are not named as eased.
records.note: UNVERIFIED: visa fee, stay length, eVisa eligibility for India, and MEA advisory; ICA site blocks plain scripted fetch so only search snippets were read. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Guatemala
records.rule: Conditional. Indian passport holders normally need a visa from a Guatemalan mission (Guatemala has no embassy in India; apply at a mission abroad, in person, about US$50 single entry or US$150 multiple entry per the Guatemalan consulate in the US, roughly Rs 4,200 or Rs 12,600). Entry without a visa for up to 90 days (extendable by 90 per Wikipedia) is reported for holders of a valid US, Canadian, Mexican or Schengen visa or US green card. Arrival form at the airport asks for a local address; onward ticket is often checked by airlines. Passport validity of 6 months beyond stay advised. Yellow fever certificate: not required for travellers from India (only if arriving from a risk country) but UNVERIFIED on an official page. UK, Australia, NZ, Japan and Korea visas do not ease entry. Guatemala is in the CA-4 zone with El Salvador, Honduras and Nicaragua, so the 90 days are shared.
records.note: The visa-free rule for US/Canada/Schengen visa holders was read on Wikipedia and a travel blog, not on a Guatemalan government page. Yellow fever and MEA advisory UNVERIFIED. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Belize
records.rule: Conditional. Indians need a visa unless they hold a valid multiple-entry US, Canadian or Schengen visa (or US/Canada residence permit), which allows visits up to 30 days without a visa (Wikipedia citing Belize exemption list; Belize immigration fee page also says visa fees do not apply to holders of a US visitor visa). Otherwise apply via Belize's honorary consulate or a mission abroad; the official Belize Immigration fee schedule lists single entry BZD 750 for Indians (about Rs 31,000, valid 6 months) and multiple entry BZD 1,000 (12 months). Indians also pay a repatriation fee of BZD 1,200 (about US$600) on arrival per Wikipedia citing Timatic, UNVERIFIED on an official page. Requirements: passport valid over 6 months, itinerary with return, funds of US$75 a day. Yellow fever certificate only if arriving from a risk country, UNVERIFIED. UK, Australia, NZ, Japan, Korea visas do not ease entry.
records.note: Fees and requirements read on immigration.gov.bz; the repatriation fee and the 30 day substitute-visa rule are from Wikipedia only. Fee page says effective 1 May 2020, may be outdated. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Guyana
records.rule: Visa required for Indian ordinary passports. India is not on Guyana's visa-free list (only Indian diplomatic and service passports are exempt) and Guyana's substitute-visa rule (US, Canada, Schengen visa gives 90 days) covers only Guatemala, Honduras and Mexico, so a US/UK/Schengen visa does not ease entry for Indians. Tourists need an approval letter from the Ministry of Home Affairs (Guyana Immigration), after which a visitor visa on arrival for up to 30 days can be issued at the airport (applications through Guyana's online services portal or a mission; fee UNVERIFIED). Expect to show hotel booking, invitation or sponsor details, funds for 30 days and return ticket. Passport valid at least 6 months. Yellow fever certificate: reportedly required for all arrivals aged 1 year and over, UNVERIFIED on an official page.
records.note: Official Guyana embassy list and consulate visa-on-arrival advisory read; fee, e-visa details and yellow fever rule UNVERIFIED. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.

records.name: Paraguay
records.rule: Visa required in advance for Indian ordinary passport holders (India is exempt only for diplomatic, official or service passports). Apply through the Embassy of Paraguay in New Delhi (its older requirements sheet lists a fee of US$100, multiple entry, original documents, police clearance with apostille, bank statements, invitation or reference letter; sheet dates from Dec 2020). Paraguay lets some applicants file online, but they must finish at an embassy or consulate (Wikipedia). One aggregator (Peninsula Visa) claims an e-visa with up to 90 days, which could not be confirmed. Passport valid at least 6 months. Yellow fever vaccination is recommended for visitors and a certificate may be required if arriving from an endemic country; India is not one, UNVERIFIED. A US, UK or Schengen visa waiver for Indians could not be verified, so none is claimed.
records.note: Official ministry site mre.gov.py blocked the request; embassy PDF is from 2020 and may be outdated. Current fee, e-visa and visa-holder easing UNVERIFIED. Probable, not final. Confirm on the official government site 2 to 3 months before travel.
